title: Binance Futures Streamlines APY Rewards For All BFUSD Holders
text: This is a general and marketing announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To provide a simplified user experience, Binance Futures will streamline the APY rewards for all BFUSD holders. From  2025-02-26 (UTC) , the previous Base and Boosted APYs will combine into a  single   APY  that applies to all BFUSD holders. With this simplified experience, there’s no need to track separate APY tiers – all holders will now enjoy the same unified rewards structure. From  2025-02-27 (UTC),  both non-traders and traders who hold BFUSD will receive the same  APY rewards . There will be no changes made to the time of rewards issuance or the token used for the APY rewards. This update will be made available on Binance Website and Binance App.  Buy and Hold BFUSD to Earn Rewards No Staking or Lock Up Required : Simply hold BFUSD to earn rewards. You can redeem BFUSD for USD Stablecoin at any time. Earn Daily Rewards : Benefit from APY generated through funding fees and staking income. Unlock your Trading Power:  Enjoy nearly 100% collateral ratio when using BFUSD as Futures trading margin in multi-asset mode. How to Buy BFUSD on Binance Website Step 1: Login to your Binance Account and go to [Futures] - [ BFUSD ]. Step 2: Click on [Buy] and enter the amount to purchase. Step 3: Accept the terms and conditions, then click [Confirm] to complete the purchase. App Step 1: Go to [Futures], tap [...], and select [BFUSD]. Step 2: Tap [Buy] and enter the amount to purchase.
